defaultValue.info: Action Points, round, reroll count, element correctional value

AvailableDice.info: Possible dice results for each rank

List.info: Expedition location names, descriptions, illustrations, and primary elements

0.title: Mushroom Shrine
0.desc: A place peppered with falling cherry blossom petals. Make some new connections here!

1.title: New Leaf City
1.desc: A prime tourist destination. One lap around all the sights and you'll have worn through your shoes!

2.title: Commerci
2.desc: A picturesque port city lined with many canals. Join a crew and take to the high seas!

3.title: Henesys
3.desc: A spacious town dotted with charming mushroom houses. Popular with tourists and Explorers alike!

4.title: Sleepywood
4.desc: A quiet town tucked into a dark forest. Despite its spookiness, there is an air of adventure here.

5.title: Leafre
5.desc: A peaceful village where the fluffy Halflingers and mighty Dragons live in harmony.

6.title: El Nath
6.desc: A scenic town blanketed in a layer of fresh snow. Footwear with good traction recommended!

7.title: Orbis
7.desc: A town nestled in the clouds above. What secrets are hiding up there?

8.title: Aquarium
8.desc: Floating in the sea, this is the perfect spot for a leisurely swim alongside aquatic abundance!

9.title: Ariant
9.desc: Scorching sand dunes as far as the eye can see. Let's just hope there's treasure to be found!

10.title: Ludibrium
10.desc: A town of toys perched atop a pair of towers. Time to embrace your inner child!

11.title: Rien
11.desc: A small island buried under ice and snow. Whose polearm do you think that is?

12.title: Mu Lung
12.desc: Where pandas train to become sages. Rumor is the sweet peaches here confer longevity!

13.title: Vanishing Journey
13.desc: A pallid town of those scattered to the wind. But even they must have memories to hold onto...

14.title: Chu Chu Island
14.desc: A bountiful island with clear skies. ...Do you suppose the fruit creatures are edible?

15.title: Lachelein
15.desc: A town where the party never stops! But why then do the eyes behind those masks look so sad?

16.title: Arcana
16.desc: A tranquil town full of mystical spirits! Why not take a look around and see what you can find?

17.title: Cernium
17.desc: A holy land that several faiths call home. Grandeur and solemnity define its halls in equal measure.

18.title: Hotel Arcus
18.desc: Located smack-dab in the desert, a rootin'-tootin' adventure is never far away!

Time.info: Expedition and return durations per rank (in hours)

0.title: There Ain't Mushroom
0.desc: Your team hurries down a narrow forest path, only to collide with a group of Horny Mushrooms! In the kerfuffle, one of your Familiars accidentally steps on a mushroom.

success.desc: Your team attacked the mushrooms, sending them fleeing into the woods. Their enemies conquered, your Familiars collected the items the mushrooms left behind.

fail.desc: Your team attacked the mushrooms, only to be overwhelmed by their fungal might! The mushrooms enacted their revenge by jumping up and down on your Familiars until they were squashed flat.

1.title: Apologize to the shrooms.

success.desc: The mushrooms calmed down and accepted your team's apology. They even gave your Familiars a gift as a gesture of good will!

fail.desc: Your team accidentally insulted the mushrooms as they tried to apologize and ended up fleeing into the woods.

1.title: Cliff Road Hoblins
1.desc: A group of Hoblins keeps a watchful eye over a narrow cliff road, their glinting arrows tracking each passing traveler.

0.title: Climb the cliff and ambush the Hoblins.

success.desc: Your team caught the Hoblins completely by surprise, driving them from the cliff and seizing their treasure.

fail.desc: The cliff crumbled beneath your team, sending them sprawling. Fortunately the Hoblins were too busy laughing to take advantage of your mistake.

1.title: Keep your head down and keep moving.

success.desc: Your team stuck to the cliff face, dodging most of the arrows as they made their escape.

2.title: Loopy Lupins
2.desc: As your team climbs a steep mountain path, they suddenly find themselves surrounded by Lupins, who have piled up a wall of bananas. The Lupins demand a toll to cross their banana battlements, but your team can't pay...

success.desc: Your team broke through the banana barricade and forced the Lupins to split. As an added perk, they even found some treasure which was quite...appeeling.

fail.desc: Your team was vanquished by a barrage of banana peels and went slipping back down the mountain path.

1.title: Challenge the Lupin leader to a wrestling match.

success.desc: One of your Familiars threw down the Lupin leader and, as a token of his respect, he gave them a gift and allowed them passage.

fail.desc: The Lupin leader was stronger than your team expected, and they were forced to turn back and find another route.

3.title: Herb Garden Guardian
3.desc: Deep in the forest, a large Stump blocks the way to a bright clearing filled with precious herbs.

success.desc: Your team uprooted the Stump and helped themselves to the herb garden, coming away with fresh supplies.

fail.desc: The Stump could not be stamped! It clamped down on your scamps, and gave them new lumps that made them look like real chumps.

1.title: Offer the Stump a fresh trim.

success.desc: Your team gave the Stump a little trim, and it was so pleased with its chic new look that it even gave them an item in thanks!

fail.desc: Your team cut the Stump too close, giving it a terrible look. They hastily fled from the Stump before it could avenge its injured pride.

4.title: Stone Cold Toll
4.desc: A Dark Stone Golem looms over a stone bridge. It seems to be extorting tolls from passing travelers.

success.desc: The Dark Stone Golem crumbled beneath your team's assault, leaving the tolls it had extorted from previous travelers as a reward.

fail.desc: Your team tried to fight the golem, but it threw them into the river. They were washed downstream and eventually cast up on the riverbank like dead fish.

1.title: Just go the long way.

success.desc: Your team checked their maps and took a detour through some side roads. The trip took them the whole day.

5.title: Thirty to Fifty Feral Hogs
5.desc: Wild pigs have run into a farmer's yard and started tearing up his fields! He looks towards your team with tears in his eyes.

success.desc: Your team chopped that pork and hocked that ham! The farmer gave them a reward for filling his larder.

fail.desc: Your team chased the pigs around the farmer's fields, trampling his crops even more. He chased your familiars away with a pitchfork.

1.title: Lead the hogs away from the farm.

success.desc: Your team laid out a trail of grain, leading the hogs away from the farm. The relieved farmer gave them an item as a reward.

fail.desc: Your team gave the pigs a taste for grain, and soon they were raiding the farmer's stores. Soon, he was Mesoless and your team was shuffling away in shame.

6.title: Dead Ahead
6.desc: The Dead Mine is full of the rattling groans of its Miner Zombies...and the shiny ore they're gathering.

success.desc: Your team carefully took out the Miner Zombies one by one and collected their loot.

fail.desc: The Miner Zombies swarmed your team...but decided that your Familiars couldn't have any brains, if they were willing to attack an entire horde on their own, and kicked them out of the mines.

1.title: Find another path to the ore.

success.desc: Your team couldn't find another path, but they did manage to defeat a few Miner Zombies and take the items they dropped.

7.title: Bone to Pick
7.desc: Your team discovers an old excavation site, which seems to have been abandoned in a hurry. As they poke through the remains looking for supplies, they're suddenly interrupted by an angry band of skeletons!

success.desc: Your team defeated the Skeleton Commander and the other skeletons fell to pieces. Your Familiars picked through the bones for some supplies.

fail.desc: Your team charged for the Skeleton Commander, but couldn't fight through the other skeletons. They barely escaped being conscripted themselves.

1.title: Fall back so they can't surround you.

success.desc: Your Familiars lured the skeletons into a narrow corridor, where only a few of the undead soldiers could attack at a time. After a grueling battle, your team stood victorious and were even able to collect a few antiquities.

fail.desc: Your Familiars lured the skeletons to a chokepoint, but the undying strength of the horde wore your team down and eventually they were forced to flee empty-handed.

8.title: Alley Cat
8.desc: As your Familiars pass through a back alley, they suddenly pause in their tracks--something is watching them. A large cat sits on a wall above them, a stolen pouch in its paws and a smirk on its face.

success.desc: Your team rushed up the wall, startling the cat and causing it to flee. Victorious, your Familiars picked up the pouch and took the item inside.

fail.desc: Your team tried to attack the cat...only to slip on a banana peel and go sliding into a pile of garbage. The cat looked on as they picked themselves up and fled--the smug swish of its tail saying more than words ever could.

1.title: Lure the cat down with Mesos.

success.desc: The cat took the bait and your team attacked as soon as it came down! The cat ran off, spitting, and your team took its pouch for themselves.

fail.desc: The cat saw through your team's ploy. It played along...only to suddenly leap at your team, claws flying. They were forced to use their health potions to flee.

9.title: Slip 'n Slime
9.desc: Your team struggles to make their way through a suspiciously slippery cave. When they light a torch to examine the floor more closely, they realize that they're standing in a nest of slimes!

0.title: Set the slimes on fire, quick!

success.desc: Your team tossed their torches into the heart of the nest and the Slimes exploded in a burst of steam and mucus. Afterwards, they managed to salvage some supplies that only needed a few rinses to wash off the goo.

fail.desc: Your team tossed their torches at the Slimes, but they missed. The flames guttered out uselessly and your Familiars were left bruised and goopy by the time they fought their way out of the cave.

1.title: Avoid the slimy floor and escape!

success.desc: Your team jumped from stone to stone and quickly made their way out of the cave.

10.title: Lost Jr. Necki
10.desc: Your team found a lost Jr. Necki near a dungeon entrance. It looked at your Familiars with wide and fearful eyes.

success.desc: Your team pulled out a map and helped the Jr. Necki figure out how to get home. In thanks, it left a little gift as it departed.

fail.desc: As your team drew near, they accidentally startled the Jr. Necki, which bit one your Familiars and fled. Well, at least you tried.

1.title: Tell it to get lost.

success.desc: Your team turned their back on the Jr. Necki and left it wandering aimlessly on its own.

11.title: Mysterious Merchant
11.desc: A Kentaurus stands in a narrow alley, guarding a cart piled high with unidentified potions and equipment.

success.desc: Despite its intimidating appearance, the Kentaurus was surprisingly friendly. Your team had a great time bartering for supplies and even got a good price.

fail.desc: Your team tried to haggle, but the Kentaurus only shook its head and covered the cart. They decided to leave before things got awkward.

1.title: Intimidate the merchant for better prices.

success.desc: The Kentaurus broke out into a cold sweat, eyeing your team's weapons. Your team picked up some items at a considerably lower price.

fail.desc: The Kentaurus smirked and whistled, causing its friends to jump out of hiding. Your team fled the alley in a hurry.

12.title: Feisty Fairies
12.desc: A flock of fairies swings from the forest trees, whistling brightly. They seem to be playing...but for some reason, your team is on edge.

0.title: Tell the fairies your best joke.

success.desc: The fairies laughed so hard they plummeted to the ground. They gave your team a small gift to commemorate their comedic brilliance.

fail.desc: Your team told their best knock knock joke...but the fairies had already heard it. They sent your team packing with a barrage of rotten fruit.

1.title: Trade stories with the fairies.

success.desc: The fairies were enthralled with your team's tales of adventure, offering them the secrets of where they could find a forest treasure in return.

fail.desc: The fairies had no interest in your team's tales, and flew off to find something more exciting.

13.title: Some More Boar
13.desc: A massive Wild Boar charges down a forest path, trampling everything in its way. As it charges towards your team, they can see a cluster of arrows protruding from its back.

0.title: Charge straight into the Wild Boar!

success.desc: Your team knocked the boar down, defeating it before it could recover. They collected its leather and loot before departing.

fail.desc: Your team was flattened by the boar, which fortunately kept running down the path instead of finishing them off.

1.title: Dodge to the side!

success.desc: Your team leapt into the trees, narrowly avoiding the boar's hooves. The boar continued down the path and vanished into the distance.

14.title: Adventure Calls...a Cactus?
14.desc: A Jr. Cactus is clumsily practicing its swordsmanship with a branch. It turns to look at your team with hopeful eyes...

success.desc: Your team showed the cactus some basic moves, which it imitated earnestly. It gave your Familiars some loot as a reward, promising that it would practice every day.

fail.desc: The Jr. Cactus was better than your team expected, and they got quite bruised when they tried to train it.

1.title: Teach the cactus wrong, as a joke.

success.desc: Your team spent some time teaching the cactus some flashy but totally useless moves. The excited Jr. Cactus gave them some of the loot it had collected, in thanks.

fail.desc: Your team tried to teach the cactus some needlessly complex moves, but it quickly lost interest. The Jr. Cactus threw down its fake sword and declared it was going to law school instead.

15.title: The Cornian Gorge
15.desc: The path forward passes through a deep gorge, where a band of Cornians lurks. The leader looks towards your team, picking up a deadly-looking weapon.

0.title: Entertain them with your witty repartee.

success.desc: Your team piqued the Cornians' interest, and soon they had the entire band hanging from their every word. Your team eventually moved on, but not before getting a gift.

fail.desc: Your team went in heavily on bad puns and the Cornians decided that they had to be put to death. Fortunately, your team was able to run faster.

1.title: Challenge the leader to a duel.

success.desc: One of your Familiars brought the leader to its knees. The other Cornians grew fearful and gave up some loot as tribute.

fail.desc: Your Familiars were defeated one by one, with the leader laughing in triumph. Fortunately, they were able to escape while the Cornians were gloating.

16.title: Hectic Homunscullo
16.desc: In the middle of the abandoned research lab, a strange test subject lurks, wailing. Is it trembling with rage or fear?

success.desc: Your team's soft words calmed the Homunscullo down. As it left the lab, it gave them a gift in thanks.

fail.desc: The Homunscullo opened its mouth wide in a sinister smile. Your team nervously backed away, leaving the troubled test subject alone.

1.title: Defeat it before it goes into a frenzy.

success.desc: Your team knocked the Homunscullo out before it could go into a frenzy. They looted the research lab before it could wake up again.

fail.desc: Your team was too late. The Homunscullo went into a frenzy, badly wounding your team and sending them running.

17.title: Knight of the Stalk and Cap
17.desc: A mushroom knight stands guard over a mountain path, spear held firmly in defiance. It declares that your team must submit to routine inspection before they can pass.

success.desc: The inspection was tedious, but your team was on their way again before too long.

1.title: Claim there's a damsel in need of rescue nearby.

success.desc: The knight fell for the trick hook, line, and sinker. Your team was given a reward for being good citizens and watched as the knight rushed off down the path.

fail.desc: The knight didn't believe your team and made sure to inspect their belongings with exceeding thoroughness. By the time your team moved on, they were exhausted.

18.title: Childish Chipmunk
18.desc: A chipmunk sits at the top of a tree, holding a massive acorn. For some reason, your team gets the sense that it's waiting to throw it at someone.

success.desc: Your team turned and found another path free of acorn-shaped peril.

1.title: Help the chipmunk improve its aim.

success.desc: The chipmunk was amazed by your team's throwing tips and gave them a gift as a reward.

fail.desc: The chipmunk used its improved accuracy to pelt your team with acorns, laughing all the while.

19.title: Clocktower Chronos
19.desc: Inside an old clocktower, a Chronos is making a terrible noise like a dying bell. And it seems there are more inside...

0.title: Try to calm the shrieking Chronos.

success.desc: Your team tried to calm the Chronos, but were attacked. Fortunately, they were able to defeat it. With the noise ended, they were able to take a few items from the clocktower.

fail.desc: Your team tried to calm the Chronos, but were attacked. They fled before the swam of Chronos could overwhelm them.

1.title: Drive the Chronos from the clocktower.

success.desc: With the Chronos defeated, the tower was silent at last. Your team found quite a few items inside.

fail.desc: The fight exhausted your team, and they were forced to retreat.

20.title: Manon of the Spring
20.desc: As your team searches the forest for fresh water, they find a Manon dozing next to a pile of treasure.

success.desc: Your team charged the sleeping Manon, screaming at the top of their lungs. Terrified, it leapt up and ran away...allowing them to take their fill of its treasure!

fail.desc: The Manon woke as soon as your team stepped into its clearing, and they only narrowly dodged its attack. They wisely fled before it could strike at them again.

1.title: Flatter the Manon by complimenting its egg.

success.desc: Manon was so pleased with your team's compliments that it gave them some treasure as a sign of friendship.

fail.desc: The Manon sensed your team's ulterior motives and pulled back, keeping its egg well away from them. Your Familiars beat a hasty retreat before it could unleash its terrible breath attack.

21.title: Toy Sword Tournament
21.desc: Toy Trojans are competing in an impromptu tournament to see which of them has the best swordsmanship, much to the delight of a cheering crowd.

success.desc: Your team fought hard, and one of your Familiars even made it to the finals! For their efforts, they were awarded a prize.

fail.desc: Sadly, your team was defeated early in the tournament, and got to watch as other warriors went on to receive the adulation of the crowd.

1.title: Challenge the most skilled warrior to a duel.

success.desc: Your team's champion fought the leader of the Toy Trojans to a draw! Eventually, everyone decided that your Familiar and the leader should split the prize, and both hailed with thunderous applause.

fail.desc: Your team's champion was defeated by the leader of the Toy Trojans and left to live with the shame of their defeat.

22.title: Ponderous Practice
22.desc: Some panda novices are clumsily practicing their martial arts against a Scarecrow. Mu Gong watches from the sidelines, his head in his hands.

success.desc: Your team demonstrated their great skill in combat, and even Mu Gong was impressed! He gave them a reward for inspiring his students.

fail.desc: Sadly, your team's skills weren't much better than the pandas! They ended up damaging the practice yard and Mu Gong asked them tersely to leave.

1.title: Walk them through the basics.

success.desc: Your team's explanation noticeably improved the pandas' techniques, earning them a reward from the grateful Mu Gong.

fail.desc: Your team launched into a long and tedious lecture on basic kicks and punches...only to suddenly realize that everyone had fallen asleep, even Mu Gong!

23.title: Meerkart
23.desc: A worn-down cart is blocking the road. As your team goes to move it, they discover that it has been turned into a playground by a group of mischievous meerkats.

success.desc: Your Familiars chased off the playful meerkats, tearing down their playground for the items inside.

fail.desc: The hissing meerkats threw stones at your team, forcing them to flee. The sight pleased the meerkats so much, it inspired a new game, which soon became popular with meerkats everywhere.

1.title: Leave the cart to the kats.

success.desc: The meerkats stand to watch your team pass and return to playing once your Familiars move away.

24.title: Mask Off
24.desc: A Wooden Mask and a Rocky Mask are on the verge of blows. They seem to be fighting over a strange piece of glowing ore.

success.desc: Your team bonked the masks on the mask, getting them both to take a step back. They decided that they would share the ore, and gave your team some items as thanks.

fail.desc: Your team brought the quarrelling masks together...by getting them to team up and defeat your Familiars, who were left groaning in the dust.

1.title: Steal the ore while they're distracted.

success.desc: Your team nabbed the ore and left the masks in the dust, only for it to crumble in their hands! At least there were some items inside.

fail.desc: Your team grabbed the ore, only to get grabbed by the masks in turn! Your Familiars were forced to flee empty-handed.

25.title: Familiar Recipe
25.desc: A Victory Plate stands in the night market, holding a fork and knife. It turns towards you team, excited to try out some new ingredients.

0.title: Give this plate a knuckle sandwich.

success.desc: Your team charged forward and knocked the plate down before it could react. They took all its items to teach it a lesson in culinary etiquette.

fail.desc: The Victory Plate easily knocked your team down. They barely managed to pick themselves and flee before becoming dinner.

1.title: Flank the plate between the stalls.

success.desc: Your team cornered the plate between the market stalls, forcing it to apologize. To make amends, it offered them a small gift.

fail.desc: The Victory Plate jumped up above your team, surprising them with a flanking attack of its own! They fled before it could cook them for dinner.

26.title: Trapped Chimera
26.desc: In the winding halls of a secret passage, your team suddenly bumps into a Chimera! It roars and moves towards your team, clearly intending to escape out past them.

success.desc: Your team struck the Chimera down before it could escape and hurt anyone. It even dropped some great loot!

fail.desc: Your Familiars were no match for the enraged Chimera's full power and only barely managed to escape with their lives.

1.title: Lead the Chimera away from the exit!

success.desc: Your team bamboozled the Chimera and tricked it into charging deeper into the secret passage. Your Familiars even found an item once they lost it in the winding corridors.

fail.desc: The Chimera realized what your team was planning and charged forward, wounding your team as they fought it back.

27.title: Midnight Hunt
27.desc: The air is suddenly rent by the bone-chilling sound of howling werewolves. As your team nervously scans the forest, they can see a pack moving through the trees.

0.title: Lure the werewolves away with food.

success.desc: Your team threw some of their rations into the trees, the smell enticing the werewolves away. They found some items where the wolves had been prowling.

fail.desc: The werewolves want your team's rations...but only for dessert! They charge for your team, who flee in terror.

1.title: Dodge the pack and run for the main road.

success.desc: Your team fled back to the main road, their racing hearts the only thing louder than the howling wolves behind them.

28.title: The Ratz Pack
28.desc: The door to an old basement swings open, the light suddenly catching a swarm of Ratz. Their gleaming eyes turn towards your team hungrily.

0.title: Clear the swarm out by force.

success.desc: Your team defeated enough of the Ratz that the rest scattered in fear, leaving a few items in their wake.

fail.desc: Your team tries to clear out the Ratz, but only get swarmed. They flee from the basement with only a collection of new scratches and bites to show for it.

1.title: Nope. Close that door now!

success.desc: Your team firmly barred the door on the scrambling Ratz and left another way, the sound of teeth on wood chasing after them.

29.title: Yeti of the Valley of the Ice
29.desc: A giant yeti stands in a ice-strewn valley, mist curling around its head with each ragged breath it takes.

0.title: Show this Yeti that fighting is a bad bet-i.

success.desc: Your team overcame the Yeti by cleverly targeting its weak spots. As a reward, they even got to take a number of items it had collected.

fail.desc: The Yeti easily bats your Familiars aside, throwing them back into the ice. Its dominance asserted, it allows your team to flee.

1.title: Lose the Yeti in the maze of cracking ice.

success.desc: Your team dodged into the ice and when the Yeti tried to follow, it slipped and fell into a ravine! Your team collected its treasures as a reward.

fail.desc: Your Familiars slipped on the ice and tumbled into a crevice. On the bright side, they lost the Yeti...but they had to search for hours to find a way out again.

0.title: Crumbling Supply Room
0.desc: Inside the crumbling walls of an abandoned castle, your team finds a partially collapsed storage room. A few old crates can be seen beneath the fallen stones.

success.desc: Your team found a few useful items in the musty old crates.

fail.desc: The crates were rigged with explosives! Your team retreated to tend to their injuries.

1.title: Prioritize the crates in the best condition.

success.desc: Your team found a crate that had been sheltered from the elements, claiming the supplies inside.

fail.desc: Your team opened a pristine crate...only to discover its contents rotted long ago. The smell drove them from the supply room.

1.title: Fathomless Ravine
1.desc: Your team is surprised to find the floor of the cave they were exploring suddenly broken by a tremendous ravine, its far side lost in the shadows. A faint light shines far below and the sound of clashing metal rises from the depths.

success.desc: As your team slowly climbed down the sheer rock face, they found a skeleton nestled in a crevice. An ancient chest was cradled in its crumbling arms, holding treasures of ages long past.

fail.desc: The rock face suddenly collapsed, causing your team to fall hard. By the time they climbed back out, they were badly bruised.

1.title: Conduct a swift and silent search around the cliff edge.

success.desc: As your team made their way carefully around the edges of the ravine, they found an old satchel nestled between some rocks. It still contained a few useful items.

fail.desc: Your team slowly felt their way through the darkness, stumbling over jagged stones without much result.

2.title: The Snoring Cave
2.desc: Deep in an ocean cave, your team runs into the sleeping Pianus, who is snoring loudly. The floor of the cave is littered with bones and sparkling treasure.

0.title: Dig deep! We're gonna be rich!

success.desc: Your team dove into the treasure pile, the sleeping giant none-the-wiser. They managed to get a good haul!

fail.desc: Your team moved towards the best treasure...only to step on some bones and awaken Pianus. They fled before they could be devoured.

1.title: Take the treasures that are easiest to carry.

success.desc: Your team carefully pocketed a few small treasures, but were forced to avoid the truly eye-catching rewards closer to the sleeping behemoth.

3.title: Whispering Tombstone
3.desc: A solitary tombstone stands in the dark woods. Symbols carved into the tomb's surface seem to murmur to your team, though they hear no sounds.

0.title: Trace the symbols onto a piece of paper.

success.desc: As your team touched the tombstone, their bodies grew cold and their minds filled with ancient knowledge.

fail.desc: Your team tried to copy the symbols...only to suddenly wake up hours later on the other side of the forest.

1.title: Translate the characters from afar.

success.desc: The symbols seemed to shift as your team tried to read them. They abandoned their efforts and searched the area for items instead.

4.title: Sealed in Stone
4.desc: A huge stone door blocks the entrance to an ancient temple. Complex symbols are carved into its surface.

0.title: Decipher the symbols and recite the incantation.

success.desc: Your team uttered the peculiar incantation and the temple door opened of its own accord, revealing treasures and the lost tomes of the temple builders.

fail.desc: Your team uttered the peculiar incantation...but made a mistake halfway through, causing the door to seal even tighter. The way would not open for them again, no matter what they tried.

1.title: Search the area for clues.

success.desc: Your team found a smaller stone shaped like a key. When they pressed it to the door, it opened, surrendering the temple's treasures.

fail.desc: Your team searched for some time...but the temple's mysteries remained undiscovered.

5.title: Haunted Library
5.desc: As your team browses the laden shelves of an ancient royal library, they find a strange room in a forgotten corner. The books there seem...strange, and as your team watches, apparitions seem to rise up to partake in the forbidden knowledge once more.

0.title: Open a dark and whispering tome.

success.desc: The book seemed to radiate the chill of the grave. An artifact was tucked within its dangerous pages.

fail.desc: Your team froze in shock as each of the apparitions turned to regard them as one. They hurriedly put the tome down and fled.

1.title: Stick to the safe shelves.

success.desc: Your team pushed the dark tomes from their minds and concentrated on gathering information to help the expedition.

fail.desc: Your team tried to read...but found themselves unable to concentrate. Somehow the whispering tomes seemed to follow them.

6.title: Stepping Stone Puzzle
6.desc: Colorful stepping stones set out a path over a plummeting ravine. If your team finds the right pattern, they may be able to cross.

0.title: Pick out a path and cross quickly.

success.desc: Your team examined the stones and found a safe pass, crossing quickly to where a treasure lay for the taking.

fail.desc: Your team examined the stones and thought they found a safe path...only to narrowly avoid plummeting into the abyss! They managed to claw their way to safety, their hearts pounding.

1.title: Stick to the largest stones.

success.desc: Your team crossed using the largest stones, avoiding the danger as well as the best rewards.

fail.desc: Your team took a lot of time to find stones they could use, but were finally able to cross.

7.title: Magical Meteor
7.desc: In center of a massive crater lies a shattered meteor of otherworldly blue stone. The power radiating from it sets your team on edge.

0.title: Touch the meteor and see what happens.

success.desc: Magic whirled around your team before the meteor broke with a sharp crack. Magical items poured from its heart.

fail.desc: The meteor hummed with a teeth-shaking whine before shattering, sending your team flying. Your team fled the area as the fragments exploded behind them.

1.title: Take a few fragments from the edge of the crater.

success.desc: Your team stayed far from the meteor and collected a few fragments for later analysis. They found a few supplies in their search.

8.title: Collapsing Mine
8.desc: Your team stands at the entrance to an unstable mine shaft. They think they can see treasures beneath the fallen stones.

success.desc: Your team rigged up some old wood beams, stabilizing the stone long enough to collect some items.

fail.desc: The mine shaft collapsed as your team tried to rig up some old wooden beams, showering them in dust and stone. Fortunately, your team was able to escape before they were entombed.

1.title: Stay in the most stable passages.

success.desc: Your team moved forward, keeping as far away from the most unstable areas as they could, and managed to pick up a few items.

fail.desc: Your team was struck by a few falling stones, but made it out of the mine safely.

9.title: Suspicious Well
9.desc: The sound of flowing water rises from a mossy old well. When your team looks inside, all they can see is darkness.

success.desc: As your Familiar was lowered down, they found a crevice in the wall of the well. An old charm was nestled inside.

fail.desc: The rope snapped, sending your Familiar plummeting into the cold water. They were blue and shivering by the time the others pulled them back out again.

1.title: Search the area around the well.

success.desc: Your team found a small box near the well with several small items inside.

fail.desc: There was nothing worth noting, but at least the well water was potable.

10.title: Ominous Treasure Chest
10.desc: Your team has found a lavishly decorated chest with an unsettling emblem carved upon it. Who knows what treasures might be inside?

success.desc: Your team discovered a chain of sinister traps hidden inside the chest. After carefully dismantling them, the treasures inside were free for the taking.

fail.desc: The chest turned out to be safe...or so your team thought. Upon opening it, they were blown back by the explosive power of a curse.

1.title: Open the lid and take a peek.

success.desc: Your team reached inside the chest blindly, fumbling for whatever they could get their hands on.

fail.desc: As soon as the lid opened a cloud of noxious dust blew out, blinding your team and sending them running.

11.title: Glacial Fissure
11.desc: As your team picks their way along the foot of a glacier, they discover a narrow fissure in the ice. A faint light shines from far within... As they look through the opening, your Familiars thinks they can make out an abandoned smuggler's hideout hidden in an ice cave.

success.desc: Your team carefully widened the fissure until they could slip inside, grabbing a number of abandoned supplies.

fail.desc: Your team broke through the ice...only for the entire cavern to collapse! Anything inside the hidden ice cave was lost in the commotion.

1.title: Stick your arm through the crack.

success.desc: Your team drew straws before finally one of them reached inside, waiting for something unpleasant to grab them. Fortunately, nothing did...but less fortunately all they could get was a pouch of penguin feathers.

12.title: Fraying Rope Bridge
12.desc: Your team finds themselves at the edge of a canyon, near an old rope bridge that creaks in the wind.

success.desc: Your team reinforced the bridge and crossed carefully. They even found supplies on the far side!

fail.desc: The bridge began to give way as your team crossed, causing them to rush over it in a panic. It collapsed just as they reached the other side.

1.title: Search for another path.

success.desc: Your team trekked for miles until they found a detour. Along the way, they discovered an old supply cache, with some salvageable items abandoned inside.

13.title: Abandoned Toy Factory
13.desc: Your team finds themselves at an abandoned toy factory, the great production line dark and silent. Unassembled parts are piled upon a nearby conveyor belt.

success.desc: A hatch opened far above your team, completed toys rained out.

fail.desc: The machines let loose a tremendous groan, as if releasing a final rasping breath. Your team tried hitting more buttons, without response.

1.title: Get the factory running again.

success.desc: Your team got the great machines to run for a few moments, producing some final toys before they spluttered to a stop.

fail.desc: Your team tried to fix the machines...only for the engines to explode as soon as they were turned on! Fortunately, nobody was hurt.

14.title: Masquerade Leftovers
14.desc: In a quiet town square, your team stumbles across the leavings of a frantic masquerade. Party favors are littered everywhere they look.

success.desc: Your team scrounged a few consumables, their seals still intact.

fail.desc: Sadly, most of the supplies were used up in the town's revelries and there was nothing for them to take.

1.title: Search through the party favors.

success.desc: The party favors were as delightful as they looked, and a few even contained helpful items.

fail.desc: Search as they might, your team could only find tacky masks and stale food. They turned away in disappointment.

15.title: Broken Wagon
15.desc: Beside a winding mountain path, your team finds a broken wagon. Overturned boxes are scattered everywhere, and fleeing footprints lead into the wilderness.

success.desc: One of the cracked boxes contained a treasure! Your team helped themselves.

fail.desc: Your team wasted several hours before realizing that someone else had already looted the wagon long before they arrived.

1.title: Organize the cargo for the owner's return.

success.desc: Your team repacked the cargo into the few unbroken boxes, taking some supplies that couldn't fit.

16.title: Glowing Pond
16.desc: A fish shining with the dancing colors of an aurora swims inside a peaceful pond. A small basket sits by the water.

success.desc: As your team cornered the shining fish it shimmered and vanished, leaving a sparkling item in its place. Your team accepted the trade.

fail.desc: Your team lost their balance and fell into the pond, barely making it out of the water. They refused to go near the shore again.

1.title: Check the basket.

success.desc: The basket held a few useful items! Your team took them and placed the basket back by the pond, leaving the fish to its own affairs.

17.title: Spider Nest
17.desc: Your team cuts their way through a wall of spiderwebs, finding themselves in a nest of Trixters. Are some of those cocoons...moving?

success.desc: Your team cut into a few cocoons, finding a handful of treasures amidst the spiders' former victims.

fail.desc: Your team was caught up by the webs as they cut into the cocoons, barely managing to get themselves free again.

1.title: Search through the webs for treasure.

success.desc: Your team found a few items beneath some desiccated cocoons. They pocketed their prizes without thinking too hard about them.

fail.desc: Your team was covered in spiderwebs. They didn't find anything, but they sure felt gross.

18.title: Hollow Stump
18.desc: Your team stumbles across an old stump infested with bugs. Something glimmers from within.

success.desc: A small box was hidden beneath the stump, with a few small items nestled inside.

fail.desc: As soon as your team touched the stump, a legion of insects crawled over them. They fled, with only some new bug bites for their trouble.

1.title: Hold your nose and reach inside.

success.desc: Your team pulled a web-covered pouch out from inside the hollow. There were a few useful items inside.

19.title: Trash or Treasure
19.desc: As your team passes through town, they find a large trash can with a sign asking people to help keep the village clean. One of your Familiars thinks that they can see something glimmering beneath all the garbage.

0.title: Get in there! I don't care what you smell!

success.desc: Your team musters their courage to dive into the ripe pile of garbage. Sure enough, there were a few usable items at the bottom, and they think it was totally worth it.

fail.desc: All your team could find in the trash can...was trash.

1.title: Pick through the uppermost layer.

success.desc: There was a small box sitting near the top, with a few slightly-soiled items inside.

20.title: Peculiar Fruit
20.desc: Your team comes across a woeful young monkey sitting beneath a tree. It seems like some older monkeys threw its pack into the branches, and it's still too young to climb up and get it.

0.title: Jump up and grab that pack!

success.desc: Your team only just managed to grab the pack and pull it down. The grateful monkey shared some of its supplies as a reward.

fail.desc: Try as they might, your team couldn't jump up high enough to reach. The young monkey was unimpressed.

1.title: Stand on each other's shoulders.

success.desc: Your team formed a pyramid, allowing the monkey to climb up safety. The grateful primate shared some of its supplies as a reward.

21.title: Temple Wishes
21.desc: Near the altar of an old temple, a fallen rope hangs limply. Strips of paper containing the wishes of the temple's vanished adherents are still tied to it.

0.title: Pull on the rope as hard as you can.

success.desc: The rope came free, bringing a pouch along with it. With strangely heavy hearts, your team pockets the item inside.

fail.desc: Your Familiars gathered together to yank on the rope, but only ended up tripping over themselves.

1.title: Carefully climb up and hang the wishes again.

success.desc: Your team hung the wishes back up above the altar, bowing in respect. As they left the temple they found an item on the path which they were sure hadn't been there before.

22.title: Wishing Well
22.desc: The bottom of a town fountain sparkles with Mesos. Your team can even make out small treasures and shining stones mixed in with the horde of coins.

0.title: Jump into the fountain and fish out the best treasures.

success.desc: Your team splashed around and fished out a few good items.

1.title: Take a few items near the water's edge.

success.desc: Your team gathered a few items from the fountain before beating a hasty retreat, not willing to tempt fate.

23.title: Rusted Prize Machine
23.desc: A faded prize machine stands abandoned. 'Test your luck!' can still be faintly read in faded lettering.

0.title: Pull the lever until it breaks!

success.desc: Your team yanked the lever over and over again, causing rare prizes to pour from the machine in a tide.

fail.desc: Your team yanked the lever over and over again, causing it to break off the machine entirely. The broken machine released no prizes.

1.title: Pull the level once.

success.desc: The lever clunked down with a heavy thud and a few ordinary prizes rolled out.

fail.desc: Your team pulled the lever...without response. The machine held onto its prizes.

24.title: Winding Corridors
24.desc: The old corridors of a dusty temple split off in all directions. Here and there your team can see odd scribbles on the wall... Are they a map, or a warning?

0.title: Follow the scribbles and check every path you find.

success.desc: The scribbles led your team to hidden rooms containing lost treasures, which they eagerly looted.

fail.desc: Your team misinterpreted the scribbles and got lost a few times. By the time they finally escaped the temple they were exhausted.

1.title: Stick to the largest hallways and move slowly.

success.desc: Your team found an old storeroom as they searched for the exit. They salvaged a few items that were gathering dust on the stone shelves.

fail.desc: Your team wandered through the temple's empty halls, finding a few items as they searched for the exit.

25.title: Unstable Teleportation Device
25.desc: Deep in a dungeon, an uncanny device sits alone. Its panels are engraved with strange coordinates and mysterious symbols.

success.desc: The device lit up with pulsing energy and opened a portal to a hidden room, which contained a few of the dungeon's best treasures.

fail.desc: The device opened a portal that deposited your team inside the dungeon's ventilation system, where they found nothing but cobwebs.

1.title: Maybe it has a safety mode.

success.desc: The device opened a portal to a hidden alcove near the dungeon's entrance, which contained a few supplies.

fail.desc: The device unleashed a torrent of harsh noise before shutting itself off entirely.

26.title: Misfortune Teller
26.desc: In a quiet alleyway, a suspicious fortune teller approaches your team while shuffling cards. They ask your team to pull a card, a wide smile on their face.

0.title: Draw from the middle of the deck.

success.desc: Your team drew a good fortune! The surprised fortune teller handed over a good prize as a reward.

fail.desc: Your team drew a bad fortune. The fortune teller smirked and wished them good luck.

1.title: Draw from the top of the deck.

success.desc: Your team drew an average fortune and received a small gift!

fail.desc: Your team drew a bad fortune, but the fortune teller only laughed and walked away.

27.title: Hotel Storage
27.desc: The floor of the hotel creaks and your team notices that one of the floorboards is slightly raised. It looks like there's a secret passage below.

0.title: Follow the passage into the dark.

success.desc: At the bottom of the stairs, your team found an underground room, which contained several forgotten treasures.

fail.desc: Your team stumbled on the stairs and twisted their ankles. Disheartened, they returned to the hotel.

1.title: Stay in the light and search the entrance.

success.desc: Your team found a few supplies in the ancient boxes stacked near the stairs.

fail.desc: As your team entered the passage, a massive rat jumped out at them. Spooked, they refused to go any further.

28.title: Old Laboratory
28.desc: Your team opens a door into a dusty old lab filled with rusty metal drawers. Some are still tagged with the numbers of old experiments.

success.desc: Your team forced an old drawer open with a metallic shriek, revealing an experimental item locked inside.

fail.desc: Your team opened every drawer they could, but only found yellowed lab reports.

1.title: Open drawers with intact labels.

success.desc: Your team opened drawers with intact labels, discovering some unopened bundles with items inside.

29.title: Shattered Shipwreck
29.desc: Inside the broken cabin of a wrecked ship, a faint light seeps through the wooden floor, lighting up the seaweed and clam shells.

0.title: Open up the floor and jump down.

success.desc: The light was emanating from a box of old emergency supplies. Your team prized it from a clam and salvaged what they could.

fail.desc: Your team cut themselves on the clam shells and retreated to treat their wounds.

1.title: Ignore the light and search the cabin.

success.desc: Your team searched the ruined cabin and found a few useful items in the wreck.

fail.desc: All your team found was useless junk.

0.title: Shining Oasis
0.desc: A small oasis sits surrounded by seemingly-endless desert, its clear water sparkling in the sun. It seems like the perfect place to rest...

success.desc: Your team fell asleep beneath the stars and awoke refreshed, as if the oasis had washed away their fatigue completely.

fail.desc: Your team fell asleep beneath the stars and awoke to find themselves surrounded by monsters, who immediately attacked. By morning, the beasts were slain, but your team had to move on without any rest.

1.title: Refill your waterskins and keep moving.

success.desc: Your team stopped to drink their fill, the cool water quenching their thirst. They returned to their trek with spirits renewed.

1.title: Potion Seller
1.desc: Your team crosses paths with a potion seller, who offers to sell them any of his potions--except, of course, for the strongest.

0.title: You're going into battle. You need his strongest potions.

success.desc: The potion seller's strongest potions renewed your team's vitality! They resumed their journey as the astonished seller looked on.

fail.desc: Your team could not handle the seller's strongest potions. They should have gone to a potion seller who sold weaker potions.

1.title: Buy a weaker potion.

success.desc: Your team chafed at the potion seller's rude demands, but ultimately purchased a weaker potion.

2.title: Snoozing Shroom
2.desc: Your team stumbles across Mushmom, who seems to have settled in for a siesta. Perhaps they could join her and rest for a while.

success.desc: Your team dozed off while Mushmom kept watch, waking up some time later completely refreshed.

1.title: Sit for a while.

success.desc: Your team rested for a bit, the aches of the road fading as they caught their breath.

fail.desc: Your team accidentally squashed Mushmom as they tried to sit down and ended up fleeing to avoid her wrath.

3.title: Moonlight Meditation
3.desc: A cushion rests on the ground, affixed by a beam of purest moonlight. It seems like your team has found someone's meditation spot.

success.desc: Sadly, enlightenment remained beyond your team's grasp...but the meditation did ease their minds and renew their spirits.

1.title: Take a breather.

success.desc: Your team shared the cushion for a while and regained some energy before moving on.

fail.desc: Your team tried to rest, but the nighttime chill set them shivering. They started walking again to warm up.

4.title: Meadow Medicine
4.desc: The trees suddenly open onto a meadow, which is full of medicinal herbs. There are even a few Bellflowers growing amongst them.

0.title: Discover the medical uses of Bellflowers.

success.desc: Your team boiled a few Bellflowers, making a redolent tea. Though it tasted extremely bitter, the tea energized your Familiars for further exploration.

fail.desc: Your team ate what they thought were Bellflower roots...only to realize that they had diced up another plant by mistake! Whatever they did eat turned out to be a phenomenal laxative.

1.title: Stick to the herbs you recognize.

success.desc: Your Familiars only gather the herbs they recognize and leave with their medical supplies refreshed.

5.title: Abandoned Camp
5.desc: Your team discovers a campsite which has clearly been abandoned for some time. Some sleeping bags sit next to a cold and ash-filled firepit.

success.desc: Your Familiars slept safe and sound in the sleeping bags, which turned out to be delightfully warm. They woke up the next morning feeling refreshed.

fail.desc: The sleeping bags were infested with bugs that feasted on your Familiars all night, leaving them exhausted and itchy by the time morning came.

1.title: Take the remaining supplies.

success.desc: Your team chowed down on the abandoned food, which fortunately remained sealed, and regained some strength.

6.title: Pepe on Ice
6.desc: A bruised and aching Pepe rests on some ice. It motions to your team, inviting them to rest and help their own sore spots.

success.desc: The cool ice compress helped your team's aches and pains, soothing some of the bruises they gathered on the road.

1.title: Use the ice for a cold drink.

success.desc: Your team filled their waterskins with crushed ice, which let them enjoy cold water throughout the rest of the day.

7.title: Hot Water
7.desc: Your team is lost in the desert, water running low... Fortunately, they happen across a jug dropped by a Water Thief, which sloshes faintly as they shake it.

success.desc: Your team carefully split the water between them until they could find another source of water, and emerged from their misadventure unscathed.

fail.desc: Your team split the water between them...but before they knew it, the jug was empty. They crawled out of the desert days later, half-mummified.

1.title: Wet your lips and save the rest.

success.desc: Your Familiars each drink the barest amount, which helps them keep moving through the summer heat.

8.title: From Whence the Bell Tolls
8.desc: An old bell tower stands in disrepair, a faint tolling audible when the wind blows through...

0.title: Yank the rope with all your strength.

success.desc: A momentous toll rings out, shaking the tower. Your Familiars' minds go blank...and when they come to, they are healed in both body and spirit.

fail.desc: A momentous toll rings out, shaking the tower. Your Familiars' minds go blank...and when they come to, their heads are throbbing painfully.

1.title: Pull the rope lightly.

success.desc: A short, clear chime rings from the bell, which clears your team's minds and lifts their spirits.

9.title: Hay is for Ribbon Pigs
9.desc: A Ribbon Pig snores away atop a massive haystack. There's plenty of room for your team to join it for a quick nap...

0.title: Lay down next to the Ribbon Pig.

success.desc: Your team curled up around the Ribbon Pig and together they fell into a deep slumber.

fail.desc: The Ribbon Pig's thunderous snoring kept your team wide awake. They weren't able to catch a wink of sleep.

1.title: Sit against the haystack for a bit.

success.desc: Your team dozed off while leaning against the hay and woke up a few minutes later feeling relaxed.

fail.desc: The musty smell of the hay bothered your Familiars, who ended up leaving before they could get much rest.
